text: DomainBot is a production LLMOps platform built on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, fine-tuned with QLoRA and served through a FastAPI gateway on Kubernetes.

The DomainBot quality gate blocks a model from shipping unless it passes three conditions: an absolute floor of 80 percent, no regression against the deployed model, and no per-category collapse below 50 percent.

Incident INC-013 was a PII over-scrubbing bug: the training pipeline replaced locations and dates with placeholders like LOCATION, which the model then emitted in answers. The fix scrubbed only email, phone, credit card, and SSN.
DomainBot caches deterministic responses in Redis. Only temperature-zero requests are cached, and the cache key includes the model revision so a new version never serves an old version's answers.
The canary rollout splits traffic by a configurable percentage with sticky per-client assignment. Rolling back is instant: set the canary percentage to zero.
DomainBot retrains always from the base model on old plus new data, never from the deployed model, to avoid compounding drift across generations.
The gateway enforces two API keys: one authenticates clients to the gateway, and a separate key authenticates the gateway to the external model endpoint.
Observability uses Prometheus and Grafana. The four golden signals are latency, traffic, errors, and saturation. Latency is tracked as a histogram so p95 and p99 can be computed.
